trigger: Interact with Wraith in the yard (companion tutorial).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wraith drops her bowl at your feet. Then her leash. Then sits like a recruit at inspection.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Yeah, partner. Everybody wants something today.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: She eats like it's a mission. Then licks the can until it shines.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You split the last of the kibble with a heel of bread. She takes the bread gently, like a favor.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [A long, betrayed look. She lies down facing away from you.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: COMPANION: tap Wraith to give orders. TRACK a scent. GUARD a spot. HOLD a person. She WARNS on her own.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Track, guard, hold. And if you growl, I listen. That's the deal.
